The equation for the reaction between hydrogen and chlorine is shown.
H2(g)+Cl 2(g)→2HCl(g)
The energy required to break the H–H bond is 436kJ /mol.
The energy required to break the Cl–Cl bond is 242kJ /mol.
The energy released when making the H–Cl bond is 431kJ /mol.
